title: Template:Wrongtitle
wikitext:
Template for use in articles that should begin in lowercase, or other such naming issues. ==Usage== ===Example=== 
{{wrongtitle|title=correct title}}
Will appear as: :''The correct title of this article is '''correct title'''. It appears incorrectly here because of technical restrictions.'' Place this template at the top of articles. :''The correct title of this article is '''{{{title|}}}'''. It appears incorrectly here because of technical restrictions.''
